channel.title: Bonfire Notes
channel.description: A Dark Souls fan blog: guides, lore and stories from Lordran

item.title: Boss Guide 10: Crossbreed Priscilla
item.description: The gentle half-dragon of the Painted World. She'll let you leave in peace; if you fight, she turns invisible and her scythe makes you bleed.

item.title: Boss Guide 9: Dark Sun Gwyndolin
item.description: An optional god who fights from the end of a long, magical hallway. Use the pillars for cover and keep running at him.

item.title: Boss Guide 8: Iron Golem
item.description: A giant suit of iron on the roof of Sen's Fortress. Hit its legs, knock it off balance, and it may fall off the roof on its own.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 10: The Painted World of Ariamis
item.description: An optional world inside a painting: snow, crows, rotting hollows, an undead dragon and a quiet half-dragon named Priscilla. How to get in, what's inside and how to get out.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 9: Anor Londo
item.description: The golden city of the gods: a spinning tower, a walk along the cathedral's flying buttresses, the two archers on the ledge, and the road to Ornstein and Smough.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 8: Sen's Fortress
item.description: A fortress built to kill you: swinging blades, rolling boulders, arrow traps, snake soldiers and chests with teeth. How to get through it and up to the Iron Golem.

item.title: Boss Guide 7: Moonlight Butterfly
item.description: A glowing butterfly that hovers just out of reach and fires magic. The fight is about waiting for it to land, then hitting it as hard as you can.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 7: Darkroot Garden and Darkroot Basin
item.description: An optional forest full of walking trees and stone knights, with the Elite Knight armor, the Moonlight Butterfly, and later the grave of Artorias and his wolf Sif.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 5: Lower Undead Burg and the Depths
item.description: Thieves and dogs in narrow alleys, a sorcerer in a locked house, the Capra Demon's tiny arena, then down into the sewers below the Burg.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 4: The Undead Parish
item.description: A church on a hill with a boar in the courtyard, knights inside, the blacksmith Andre below and the first Bell of Awakening on the roof.

item.title: Class Build: Deprived
item.description: The Deprived starts with nothing but a club, a plank and 11 in every stat. The blank-slate class for players who want to build exactly what they choose: stats, weapons, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Cleric
item.description: The Cleric starts with a mace, high Faith and the Heal miracle. A Faith fighter who heals himself and later throws lightning: stats, miracles, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Pyromancer
item.description: The Pyromancer starts at level 1 with Fireball and an axe. Fire magic doesn't depend on stats, so every point can go into survival: stats, spells, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Sorcerer
item.description: The Sorcerer starts with Soul Arrow, high Intelligence and the most spell slots. A ranged magic build that hits hardest in the game once it gets going: stats, spells, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Hunter
item.description: The Hunter starts with a sword, a short bow and good Dexterity. A Dexterity archer who softens enemies from range and finishes them up close: stats, weapons, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Bandit
item.description: The Bandit starts with the highest Strength and Endurance and a Battle Axe. A pure Strength brawler that swings the biggest weapons in the game: stats, weapons, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Thief
item.description: The Thief starts with the best Dexterity, a dagger made for critical hits and a Master Key that opens shortcuts. A backstab and parry build: stats, weapons, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Wanderer
item.description: The Wanderer starts with high Dexterity and a curved sword built for speed. A light, fast Dexterity build that wins by dodging: stats, weapons, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Knight
item.description: The Knight starts with the most health, full armor and a sturdy shield. The easiest way to learn Dark Souls, built into a heavy Strength tank: stats, weapons, gear and what to level.

item.title: Class Build: Warrior
item.description: The Warrior starts with balanced Strength and Dexterity and one of the best early shields. A quality build that can use almost any weapon: stats, weapons, gear and what to level.

item.title: Boss Guide 6: Chaos Witch Quelaag
item.description: Half woman, half giant spider, guarding the second bell at the bottom of Blighttown. How to dodge her lava and her fire blast, and where to stand.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 6: Blighttown
item.description: A shantytown of rickety scaffolding over a poison swamp. Blowdart snipers, a cannibal invader and the way to the second Bell of Awakening.

item.title: Start Here: Lordran Guides Hub
item.description: Every guide on Bonfire Notes in one place, in the order you'll need them: a build for every starting class, area walkthroughs and boss guides.

item.title: Boss Guide 5: Gaping Dragon
item.description: A huge dragon with a mouth down its whole body, deep in the Depths. Its attacks, how to stay safe at its side, and how to cut its tail for a giant axe.

item.title: Boss Guide 4: Capra Demon
item.description: A tiny room, two dogs and a demon with two swords. Why your first seconds decide this fight, and the exact path to safety.

item.title: Boss Guide 3: Bell Gargoyles
item.description: Two flying gargoyles on a church roof, guarding the first Bell of Awakening. Kill the first one fast, cut its tail for a free axe, and summon help.

item.title: Boss Guide 2: Taurus Demon
item.description: A huge demon on a narrow wall in the Undead Burg. Use the ladder behind you for free plunging attacks, then fight between its legs.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 3: The Undead Burg
item.description: Hollow soldiers, firebombs from the rooftops, a merchant with a katana, the Taurus Demon and a red dragon on a bridge. How to get through the Undead Burg alive.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 2: Firelink Shrine
item.description: Your new home base. Who to talk to, which paths will get you killed, where the free big sword is, and the right way to go.

item.title: Boss Guide 1: Asylum Demon
item.description: The first boss of Dark Souls. Why you run the first time, how to open with a huge plunging attack, and the safe spot to stand.

item.title: Walkthrough Part 1: Northern Undead Asylum
item.description: From your prison cell to the crow that carries you to Lordran. Every step of the tutorial area, including how to deal with the demon you can't beat yet.

item.title: The Age of Fire, Explained
item.description: Dark Souls hides its story in item text and quiet conversations. Here is the big picture in plain words. (Spoilers ahead.)

item.title: Ornstein and Smough: A Calm Guide to the Anor Londo Duo
item.description: The most famous wall in Dark Souls is two bosses at once. Here's how to keep your cool and win.

item.title: Your First Hours in Lordran: 10 Beginner Tips
item.description: The ten things I wish someone had told me before my first trip through the Undead Burg.

item.title: Why Dark Souls Still Matters
item.description: Fifteen years after it first lit the fire, Dark Souls still shapes how games are made. Here is why it holds up.
